Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Apply ANSI R.p: Subtracts interpolated ANSI RETSPL values (chosen by `Speaker`) from an ASTF magnitude curve; errors for an unrecognised speaker.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Apply Microp.p: Reads a correction-curve text file, interpolates it with CAL-Interp and subtracts it from a CAL-Data magnitude/phase curve.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Compute Grou.p: Loads a calibration file, unwraps its phase and fits a line to phase vs frequency to return group delay in ms.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Get Max SPL..p: Reads a speaker calibration file (CAL-Read Data) and interpolates it at the requested frequencies to return max SPL per frequency, adding a dB term computed from the front-panel `VDAC` value.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Interp (Fs,.p: Interpolates a calibration curve (dB magnitude, phase) onto the FFT grid defined by Fs and Npts; also returns the complex spectrum.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Interp.vi.p: Interpolates a calibration curve (dB magnitude, phase) onto a uniform grid of spacing `df`; also returns the complex spectrum.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Plot Data.vi.p: Reads a calibration file and adds it as a colour-mapped plot to a magnitude graph (by refnum) at a given plot index.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-SPL to V Int.p: Loads a calibration file and interpolates it at `Fi` to return the voltage amplitude and phase (cycles) that produce a requested dB SPL.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CAL-Smooth.vi.p: Smooths a magnitude array with a Savitzky-Golay filter.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/CIE2T-Compute Ma.p: Computes max SPL for two tones (f1, f2) from an FFT magnitude spectrum, probe-mic gain, attenuation and the named acoustic system's calibration file.

Common VIs/Analysis VIs/Compute Peak SPL.p: Synthesises a Waveform Class object, applies a speaker calibration in the frequency domain (FFT, multiply, inverse FFT) and returns the peak SPL.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Read Data.vi.p: Parses a calibration text file (regex header parsing) into frequency, magnitude and phase arrays plus Fs. This is the existing `.calib` reader.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Save Data V2..p: Writes a calibration file (magnitude, phase, frequency, unsmoothed magnitude, smoothing and stimulus parameters, probe-tube file) with a version/date header, backing up any existing file first.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Save Data.vi.p: Writes CAL-Data plus stimulus and response parameters to a calibration text file, after creating a backup.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Save Data.vim.p: Malleable variant of CAL-Save Data: `Response` is a variant; deletes an existing file so formats do not clash, with optional backup.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Save Smoothed.p: Rewrites an existing calibration file with smoothed magnitudes and the smoothing parameters, parsing the old file by regex.

Common VIs/File IO VIs/CAL-Update Value..p: Loads a calibration file, replaces the magnitude at the two bins bracketing a frequency with a ceiling value, and re-saves it.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/Apply Audi.p: FFTs a noise buffer, adds interpolated audiogram compensation between the file's min and max frequencies (zero elsewhere) and inverse-FFTs; returns the noise and reference adjustment.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/Audiogram-.p: Reads an audiogram text file into frequency and magnitude arrays plus min/max frequency and minimum-threshold summaries.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/Design Inv.p: Interactive (event-loop) VI that builds a masker noise from a calibration file and stimulus/masker specs and shows its spectrum, RMS and max level.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/IFNoise-An.p: Takes the newest mic buffer from the Data Available queue, windows and FFTs it, and accumulates magnitude/SPL sums in the IFNoise runtime cluster.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/IFNoise-Cr.p: Generates uniform white noise and, when `Inverse Filter` is true, shapes it with InvFilter-Create Noise from the calibration file; returns noise, magnitude spectrum and max SPL.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/IFNoise-In.p: Initialises PXI DAQ for noise play/record: resolves AO/AI channels for the speaker and input source, sets AI/AO config and gains from attenuation, loads the signal bank.
Builds the IFNoise runtime: resolves speaker and probe-tube calibration paths from experiment state, loads and interpolates them, creates the stimulus and initialises hardware.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/IFNoise-Pl.p: Converts IFNoise runtime sums into averaged magnitude spectra, a time-waveform cluster and an overall dB SPL value for display.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/IFNoise-Up.p: Loads the next circular noise segment (Noise-Circular Play) into the AO signal bank.

Common VIs/Inverse Filter VIs/InvFilter-.p: Checks InvFilt-Params with a single divide/greater-than test and returns an error cluster when it fails.

Makes inverse-filtered noise: generates white noise (uniform or Gaussian, with a `seed` input) or takes `Noise In`, subtracts the calibration-derived spectrum in dB via FFT/inverse FFT; returns noise, max level and spectrum.
Loads a calibration file, interpolates it to the (Fs, Npts) grid and builds the inverse-filter magnitude/phase between Fmin and Fmax (optional brickwall); returns a reference level.
Builds the inverse-filter spectrum from a calibration file and InvFilt-Params and returns its impulse response by inverse FFT.

Common VIs/Mic Sensitivity VIs/Cal Mic S.p: Top-level UI VI (UI loop + measurement loop) that measures calibration-microphone sensitivity for a device and returns it.

Common VIs/Mic Sensitivity VIs/Sub VIs/C.p: Initialises TDT hardware (RPcoX circuit, coerced sampling rate, channel tags) for the mic-sensitivity measurement.
Reads the calibration log text file into a 2-D string table and returns the last logged value.
Reads saved CalMic-Params from a config file (Read Anything).

Common VIs/Stimulus VIs/CAL-Create Stimu.p: Creates the calibration chirp: flat magnitude between Fmin and Fmax with Schroeder-style phase, built by inverse FFT.

Common VIs/Typedefs/CAL-Globals.vi.p: No connector pane and no diagram operations in lvkit output (consistent with a global-variable VI).

Reads FF-Parameters from the config file (Read Anything).
